title: Vishnu
provenance: From inner sanctum of Mahadeva temple near Curdi village, Goa.
brief_description: Standing Vishnu figure mutilated not compete part of Acc no 05
detailed_description: Right portion of the broken frame of a Vishnu Vimana figure showing two standing attendents. One is holding a snake and the other one is in Kalihasta (empty hand). The main deity Vishnu was initially flanked by - two elephants and four attendants (two on each side)and one yati.
